subject: general
question: Which cabinet minister of Inda in June 2025 held bilateral talks with Dong Jun of China at the conclave of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) in the Chinese port city of Qingdao, with a focus on maintaining peace and tranquillity along the Line of Actual Control (LAC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raj Nath Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raj Nath Singh**, the Defence Minister of India, held bilateral talks with **Dong Jun**, a senior Chinese official, during the **Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) conclave** in **June 2025**.
 
• The discussions took place in the **Chinese port city of Qingdao**, which has previously hosted high-profile international summits.
 
• The talks primarily focused on maintaining **peace and tranquillity along the Line of Actual Control (LAC)**, which is the de facto border between India and China.
 
• The meeting aimed to address ongoing border tensions and reinforce agreements to avoid escalations in sensitive areas, particularly in regions like **Eastern Ladakh**.
 
• Raj Nath Singh also emphasized the importance of resolving disputes through **diplomatic and peaceful means**, aligning with India's consistent approach to international relations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO):**

 
 
• The SCO is a regional intergovernmental organization established in **2001**, with a primary focus on political, economic, and security cooperation.
 
• Its founding members include China, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan. India and Pakistan joined as full members in **2017**.
 
• The organization provides a platform for member states to collaborate on issues like counter-terrorism, border security, and economic development.
 
 
 
• **Line of Actual Control (LAC):**
 
 
• The LAC is a 3,488 km long boundary between **India and China**, separating Indian-controlled territory from Chinese-controlled territory.
 
• It is divided into three sectors: the **Western Sector** (Ladakh), the **Middle Sector** (Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand), and the **Eastern Sector** (Sikkim and Arunachal Pradesh).
 
• Frequent tensions arise along the LAC, requiring diplomatic and military engagement to maintain stability.
 
 
 
• **India-China Border Relations:**
 
 
• The two nations have a history of border disputes, with significant conflicts like the **1962 Sino-Indian War** and recent standoffs like the **Galwan Valley clash in 2020**.
 
• To manage disputes, both countries have signed agreements such as the **1993 Border Peace and Tranquillity Agreement** and the **1996 Confidence-Building Measures Agreement**.
 
• Despite agreements, incidents of transgressions and military build-ups continue to strain relations.
 
 
 
• **Raj Nath Singh:**
 
 
• He is a senior leader of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and has served as the **Defence Minister of India** since **2019**.
 
• Under his leadership, India has strengthened its defence capabilities and emphasized self-reliance through the **Atmanirbhar Bharat** initiative in the defence sector.
 
• He has played a key role in addressing border security challenges and modernizing the armed forces.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Qingdao:**

 
 
• A major port city in **Shandong Province, China**, known for hosting international events like the **SCO Summit** in 2018.
 
• It is strategically significant due to its location and infrastructure, making it a preferred venue for diplomatic engagements.
 
 
 
• **Significance of India-China Talks:**
 
 
• Such bilateral meetings are crucial for reducing border tensions and fostering cooperation in other areas like trade and regional security.
 
• They also reflect India's commitment to peaceful conflict resolution and adherence to international norms.
 
 
 
• **India’s Defence Diplomacy:**
 
 
• India has been actively engaging with international partners through platforms like the **Quad, SCO, and BRICS** to strengthen its strategic partnerships.
 
• The Defence Minister's participation in global forums underscores India's increasing role in shaping regional and global security dynamics.
